title: File:Copy (2) of Teresa Hsu 20100926 155104.jpg
depicts: Teresa Hsu at 112, head and shoulders, short white hair, floral blouse, smiling gently against garden greenery
note: Taken 26 Sep 2010 (EXIF date in the filename). Sharp, well lit, face clear; the only openly licensed photo of her found. No openly licensed photos of her earlier years exist: the NAS photos from 2009 and 2011 and the SCWO and Straits Times photos all need permission.

title: File:Society For The Aged Sick—Singapore.jpg
depicts: The Society for the Aged Sick at 130 Hougang Avenue 1: a cream building with tiered orange tiled roofs behind a low wall and gate
note: Taken 8 Sep 2007. This is the Hougang successor to the 1965 Jalan Payoh Lai home, not the original bungalow; caption it accordingly. Her last flat was attached to these premises. Modest resolution.

title: File:Heart to Heart Centre—Singapore.jpg
depicts: The Heart to Heart Centre at 130 Hougang Avenue 1, on the Society for the Aged Sick premises
note: Taken 8 Sep 2007, same photographer and day as the Society photo. Modest resolution.

title: File:(SGP-Singapore) Kwong Wai Shiu Hospital 2026-03-31.jpg
depicts: Kwong Wai Shiu Hospital, Serangoon Road, where she was the unsalaried matron from about 1963
note: A modern photo (31 Mar 2026) of a hospital she worked at in the 1960s. Caption it as 'today' and don't present it as period.

title: File:View of Swatow Harbour MET DP165632.jpg
depicts: Swatow (Shantou) harbour: a colonnaded foreign building on a rocky hillside above the bay, sailing ships at anchor
artist: John Thomson (Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access)
note: Albumen print, about 30 years before she was born. It shows the treaty-port harbour, not her village of Kak Chioh. Use it for 'the Swatow she was born into', captioned c.1869.
